intro: Model banane ke baad usse reliably ship karna MLOps hai: versioning, artifacts, config, health checks aur rollback. Is section me ye concepts pure Python me implement hote hain, taaki Docker/Git/AWS ke commands ka logic clear ho.
theory: Har model artifact ke saath metadata hona chahiye: version, training data hash, metrics aur code commit. Sirf .pkl file bhejna reproducibility todta hai.
Config environment se aata hai, code se nahi. Same image dev/staging/prod me chalti hai; farq sirf env vars ka hota hai.
Health check do level ke hote hain: liveness (process zinda) aur readiness (dependencies ready). Deploy ke baad readiness fail ho to traffic nahi bhejna chahiye.
Rollback plan pehle se hona chahiye: previous artifact version aur config ka reference rakho, aur deploy ko reversible rakho.
Retries idempotent operations par karo; har retry ka limit aur backoff ho, warna outage double load ban jata hai.
syntax:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "serve.py"]

docker build -t churn-api:1.4.0 .
docker run -e MODEL_VERSION=1.4.0 -p 8000:8000 churn-api:1.4.0
aws ecs update-service --cluster prod --service churn --force-new-deployment

git tag -a v1.4.0 -m "churn model 1.4.0"
git push origin v1.4.0

explain: Liveness aur readiness alag signals hain — readiness dependencies par depend karti hai.
Output ko print se verify karo.

examples.code:
import hashlib
import json

artifact = b'weights-v2'
manifest = {
    'version': '1.4.0',
    'sha256': hashlib.sha256(artifact).hexdigest(),
    'metrics': {'auc': 0.91, 'latency_ms': 42},
}

GATES = {'auc': 0.90, 'latency_ms': 50}
blocked = [name for name, limit in GATES.items()
           if (manifest['metrics'][name] < limit if name == 'auc' else manifest['metrics'][name] > limit)]

print(json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True))
print('release allowed:', not blocked, 'blocked by:', blocked)
explain: Artifact hash + metric gates se release decision reproducible aur auditable banta hai.
Ye snippet end-to-end flow dikhata hai.
Output ko project/interview me evidence ki tarah use karo.

realWorld: Model registry me har version ke metrics aur artifact hash hote hain; production me kaunsa version hai ye ek query se pata chalta hai.
Blue/green ya canary deploy se naya model thode traffic par test hota hai, phir promote ya rollback.
CI me tests + build + image scan chalte hain; CD sirf tagged commit par deploy karta hai.

interview.q: Model artifact ke saath kya version karna chahiye?
interview.a: Weights, preprocessing pipeline, config schema, training data snapshot/hash, metrics aur code commit. Inke bina rollback aur reproducibility dono adhoore hain.

interview.q: Liveness aur readiness probe me fark batao.
interview.a: Liveness batata hai process zinda hai; fail ho to restart. Readiness batata hai traffic le sakta hai (DB/model loaded); fail ho to load balancer hata deta hai.

interview.q: Docker image me secrets kyun nahi daalne chahiye?
interview.a: Image layers me secret permanently reh jata hai aur registry se leak ho sakta hai. Secrets runtime env/secret manager se do.

interview.q: Canary deploy kaise kaam karta hai?
interview.a: Naya version thode percentage traffic par bhejte hain, metrics compare karte hain, phir promote ya rollback. Isse blast radius chhota rehta hai.

debugging.broken:
prices = [100, 200]
total = 0
for p in prices:
    total = p
print(total)
debugging.error: Logic error — total 200 aata hai, sum 300 hona chahiye
debugging.why: Assignment purani value replace karta hai; accumulator chahiye. Ye MLOps + Docker + Git + AWS ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: total += p use karo ya sum(prices).
debugging.correct:
prices = [100, 200]
total = 0
for p in prices:
    total += p
print(total)
debugging.lesson: Logic bugs exception nahi dete — chhote sample par expected value likho.

debugging.error: Logic error — pehla do items chahiye the, sirf pehla aaya
debugging.why: Slice ka end exclusive hota hai; 0:1 sirf index 0 deta hai. Ye MLOps + Docker + Git + AWS ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: Slice boundaries exclusive hoti hain — range jaisa hi rule.

debugging.error: TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str
debugging.why: String concatenation ko dono taraf str chahiye; Python implicit conversion nahi karta. Ye MLOps + Docker + Git + AWS ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: f-string ya str() se explicit conversion karo.
debugging.lesson: TypeError type mismatch batata hai — conversion explicit karo.

debugging.error: IndexError: list index out of range
debugging.why: List me sirf 0 aur 1 index hain; 5 par kuch nahi. Ye MLOps + Docker + Git + AWS ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: Index se pehle length check karo ya safe getter use karo.
debugging.correct:
scores = [10, 20]
print(scores[1] if len(scores) > 1 else None)
debugging.lesson: IndexError off-by-one aur empty collection ka signal hai.
